requirements.quote: Are you a New York State Certified M/WBE?
requirements.text: Indicate if the M/WBE is certified in New York State.

requirements.quote: WORK/SERVICES to be PROVIDED BY M/WBE SUBCONTRACTOR/SUPPLIER
requirements.section: WORK/SERVICES to be PROVIDED BY M/WBE SUBCONTRACTOR/SUPPLIER
requirements.text: Specify the work or services to be provided by the M/WBE subcontractor or supplier.

requirements.quote: The above work will not be further subcontracted without the express written permission of the contractor and notification of the Office.
requirements.text: Do not subcontract the work further without written permission and notification.

requirements.quote: This form is to be submitted with bid attached to the Subcontractor's Information Form in a sealed envelope for each certified Minority or Women-Owned Business enterprise the Bidder/Awardee/Contractor proposes to utilize as subcontractors, service providers or suppliers.
requirements.section: INSTRUCTIONS FOR M/WBE SUBCONTRACTORS AND SUPPLIERS' LETTER
requirements.text: Submit the form with the bid in a sealed envelope for each certified M/WBE proposed.
